items.text:
Get a few pennies collecting scrap. Owe more in docking fees. Run out of fuel, not to be able to afford to leave the station to fly to an unknown location to investigate a dead body. Get debt-locked. Uninstall. 

There a harsh games. But this takes the cake.

Also - pixelated 2d clutter on the floor makes no sense, you have no clue what to salvage and what to ignore. And, no real flight, just an old radar style screen with more 2d map navigation.

 Avoid.
items.text_zh:
捡废料赚几个小钱。欠的停靠费却更多。燃料耗尽，连离开空间站飞去一个未知地点调查一具尸体都负担不起。陷入债务锁死。卸载。

有些游戏很严苛。但这个简直登峰造极。

另外——地板上那些像素化的2D杂物毫无意义，你根本不知道什么该回收、什么该无视。而且，没有真正的飞行，只是一个老式雷达风格的屏幕配上更多的2D地图导航。

避开。
